issue.title: [buildsystem]: Errors are seen during privilege escalation

failure.body:
#### Description

**Errors in the log observed during image build:**
```
user@server: sonic-buildimage$ tail -F target/docker-base-bullseye.gz.log
 ---> 0048183b631d
Step 5/40 : COPY vcache/ /sonic/target/vcache/docker-base-bullseye
 ---> 3a360af617b3
Step 6/40 : RUN dpkg -i /usr/local/share/buildinfo/sonic-build-hooks_1.0_all.deb
 ---> Running in 30fad432ed25
Selecting previously unselected package sonic-build-hooks.
(Reading database ... 6661 files and directories currently installed.)
Preparing to unpack .../sonic-build-hooks_1.0_all.deb ...
Unpacking sonic-build-hooks (1.0) ...
Setting up sonic-build-hooks (1.0) ...
Removing intermediate container 30fad432ed25
 ---> 177169452e60
Step 7/40 : ENV IMAGENAME=docker-base-bullseye
 ---> Running in 54a11924137d
Removing intermediate container 54a11924137d
 ---> 96c1e9d864f2
Step 8/40 : ENV DISTRO=bullseye
 ---> Running in 05dd3e5a4109
Removing intermediate container 05dd3e5a4109
 ---> 9bdad69e41fe
Step 9/40 : RUN pre_run_buildinfo docker-base-bullseye
 ---> Running in 178489d1ae0d
/usr/local/share/buildinfo/scripts/buildinfo_base.sh: line 24: sudo: command not found
/usr/local/share/buildinfo/scripts/buildinfo_base.sh: line 24: sudo: command not found
/usr/local/share/buildinfo/scripts/buildinfo_base.sh: line 24: sudo: command not found
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. make `target/sonic-vs.bin`

#### Describe the results you received:
```
/usr/local/share/buildinfo/scripts/buildinfo_base.sh: line 24: sudo: command not found
```

#### Describe the results you expected:
No errors expected

#### Output of `show version`:
* N/A

#### Output of `show techsupport`:
* N/A

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-build-hooks/scripts/buildinfo_base.sh#L24
```
PKG_CACHE_FILE_NAME=${PKG_CACHE_PATH}/cache.tgz
sudo chown $USER $(dirname $PKG_CACHE_PATH)
mkdir -p ${PKG_CACHE_PATH}
```

resolution.title: [buildsystem]: Fix error 'chown: missing operand after'
resolution.description:
Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13395

This fix resolves ownership configuration for `vcache`:
```
Step 24/40 : RUN pip3 install j2cli
 ---> Running in fcc39df62a98
chown: missing operand after '/sonic/target/vcache/docker-base-bullseye'
Try 'chown --help' for more information.
```

Originally the issue was introduced here: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/13287

#### Why I did it
* To fix ownership configuration
